title: Neural Methods for Effective, Efficient, and Exposure-Aware Information Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the disparity in expected exposure (EE-D) and relevance (EE-R) for individual documents of comparable relevance using stochastic ranking policies, the Plackett-Luce model, and Gumbel noise sampling.

Evaluating group-level exposure parity by categorizing candidate documents into groups (using discretized PageRank as a proxy attribute) and calculating the uniformity of expected exposure across these groups.
